statements.label: supported
statements.text: Deleting ALKBH5 only in macrophages blocked angiotensin II-induced MMT and eased cardiac fibrosis and dysfunction.
statements.evidence: macrophage-specific knockout of ALKBH5 inhibits Ang II-induced MMT, and subsequently ameliorates cardiac fibrosis and dysfunction.
statements.note: The abstract reports that macrophage-specific ALKBH5 knockout inhibits Ang II-induced MMT and ameliorates cardiac fibrosis and dysfunction.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The ALKBH5/IL-11 axis drives cardiac fibrosis in human hypertension patients just as it does in mice.
statements.evidence: contributes to hypertensive cardiac fibrosis and dysfunction in mice, and thereby identify potential targets for cardiac fibrosis therapy in patients.
statements.note: The abstract demonstrates the axis in mice and only names patients as a therapeutic prospect, without showing it operates in them.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Under angiotensin II-induced hypertension, cardiac macrophages from circulating monocytes showed increased expression of the m6A demethylase ALKBH5.
statements.evidence: under angiotensin II (Ang II)-induced hypertension, with accompanying increased expression of the RNA N6-methyladenosine demethylases, ALKBH5.
statements.note: The abstract reports that under Ang II-induced hypertension these macrophages show increased expression of the m6A demethylase ALKBH5.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: ALKBH5 stripped m6A marks from IL-11 mRNA, stabilising the transcript and lifting IL-11 protein levels.
statements.evidence: ALKBH5-mediated m6A demethylation, leading to increased IL-11 mRNA stability and protein levels.
statements.note: The abstract reports that ALKBH5-mediated m6A demethylation of IL-11 mRNA increases its stability and protein levels.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: ADAR1 granted the resistant cells both chemoresistance and self-renewal, and this relied on its RNA-editing activity.
statements.evidence: ADAR1 confers chemoresistance and self-renewal in an RNA editing-dependent manner.
statements.note: The abstract states ADAR1 confers chemoresistance and self-renewal in an RNA editing-dependent manner.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In the resistant organoid lines, JAK/STAT signaling and its downstream effector ADAR1 were jointly upregulated.
statements.evidence: JAK/STAT signaling and its downstream, adenosine deaminases acting on RNA 1 (ADAR1), are shown to be concomitantly upregulated in the resistant lines.
statements.note: The abstract reports JAK/STAT signaling and its downstream ADAR1 are concomitantly upregulated in the resistant lines.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: ADAR1 inhibitors reverse chemoresistance more effectively than SCD1 inhibitors in the gastric cancer organoids.
statements.evidence: Pharmacological inhibition of SCD1 abrogates chemoresistance and tumor-initiating cell frequency.
statements.note: The abstract tests only SCD1 inhibition and never compares an ADAR1 inhibitor against an SCD1 inhibitor.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: ADAR1 edited the 3'UTR of SCD1, strengthening KHDRBS1 binding and stabilising the SCD1 transcript.
statements.evidence: ADAR1-mediated A-to-I editing on 3'UTR of stearoyl-CoA desaturase (SCD1) increases binding of KH domain-containing, RNA-binding, signal transduction-associated 1 (KHDRBS1), thereby augmenting SCD1 mRNA stability.
statements.note: The abstract reports ADAR1 editing of the SCD1 3'UTR increases KHDRBS1 binding and augments SCD1 mRNA stability.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Nucleolin was lactylated mainly at lysine 477 by the acyltransferase P300 when glycolysis was hyperactive.
statements.evidence: NCL was lactylated predominantly at lysine 477 by the acyltransferase P300 in response to a hyperactivity of glycolysis
statements.note: The abstract states nucleolin is lactylated predominantly at lysine 477 by P300 in response to glycolysis hyperactivity.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Glycolysis promotes the P300-catalysed lactylation of nucleolin in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
statements.evidence: glycolysis promotes P300-catalyzed lactylation of nucleolin
statements.note: The abstract states that glycolysis promotes P300-catalyzed lactylation of nucleolin.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Lactylated nucleolin bound the MADD primary transcript and enabled MADD translation by bypassing a splicing event that makes a premature stop codon.
statements.evidence: lactylated NCL bound to the primary transcript of MAP kinase-activating death domain protein (MADD) and led to efficient translation of MADD by circumventing alternative splicing that generates a premature termination codon.
statements.note: The abstract reports lactylated NCL binds the MADD transcript and enables its translation by circumventing a splicing event that creates a premature termination codon.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Blocking P300 lactyltransferase activity shrinks established iCCA xenograft tumors.
statements.evidence: NCL lactylation, MADD translation and subsequent ERK activation promoted xenograft tumor growth and were associated with overall survival in patients with iCCA.
statements.note: The abstract links the pathway to xenograft growth but tests no P300 inhibitor or regression of established tumors.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: circSCMH1 treatment improves long-term functional recovery in human stroke patients.
statements.evidence: Vascular repair is considered a key restorative measure to improve long-term outcomes after ischemic stroke.
statements.note: Improving long-term outcomes is stated as background; the study's recovery data come from male mice and monkeys, not patients.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: circSCMH1 enhances vascular repair after stroke by way of FTO-regulated m6A methylation.
statements.evidence: circSCMH1 enhances vascular repair via FTO-regulated m 6 A methylation after stroke
statements.note: The abstract concludes that circSCMH1 enhances vascular repair via FTO-regulated m6A methylation after stroke.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: circSCMH1 drove vascular repair in the peri-infarct cortex of both male mice and male monkeys after photothrombotic stroke.
statements.evidence: circSCMH1 in promoting vascular repair in peri-infarct cortex of male mice and male monkeys after photothrombotic (PT) stroke
statements.note: The abstract identifies circSCMH1 as promoting vascular repair in the peri-infarct cortex of male mice and male monkeys after PT stroke.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In endothelial cells, circSCMH1 pushed ubiquitinated FTO into the nucleus, demethylating Plpp3 mRNA and lifting Plpp3 expression.
statements.evidence: circSCMH1 increased the translocation of ubiquitination-modified fat mass and obesity-associated protein (FTO) into nucleus of endothelial cells (ECs), leading to m 6 A demethylation of phospholipid phosphatase 3 (Plpp3) mRNA and subsequently the increase of Plpp3 expression in ECs.
statements.note: The abstract reports circSCMH1 moves ubiquitinated FTO into the EC nucleus, demethylating Plpp3 mRNA and increasing Plpp3 expression.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Histone lactylation fuelled by lactic acid from mutant KRAS tumor cells switched on circATXN7 transcription.

statements.note: The abstract reports histone lactylation from mutant-KRAS tumor lactic acid directly activates circATXN7 transcription.

statements.label: not_addressed

statements.note: The study addresses cytotoxic CD8+ T lymphocytes and never examines CD4+ helper T cells.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Deleting circAtxn7 from CD8+ T cells increased the efficacy of anti-PD1 therapy across several tumor models in female mice.
statements.evidence: while also increases anti-PD1 efficacy in multiple tumor models in female mice.
statements.note: The abstract reports that ablating circAtxn7 in CD8+ T cells increases anti-PD1 efficacy in multiple tumor models in female mice.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: circATXN7 decides whether tumor-specific cytotoxic T lymphocytes die by AICD, acting by switching off NF-κB.
statements.evidence: circATXN7, an NF-κB-interacting circular RNA, governs T cell sensitivity to AICD by inactivating NF-κB.
statements.note: The abstract states circATXN7 governs T cell sensitivity to AICD by inactivating NF-κB.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The N-terminal fragments of GSDMB isoforms 3 and 4 set off pyroptosis, whereas isoforms 1, 2, and 5 did not.

statements.note: The abstract reports the N-terminal fragments of isoforms 3 and 4 caused pyroptosis while isoforms 1, 2, and 5 did not.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Across the tumor cell lines examined, GSDMB isoforms 1 to 3 were the most abundant.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Expression of the cytotoxic GSDMB3/4 isoforms, unlike the GSDMB1/2 isoforms, tracked with better outcomes in bladder and cervical cancers.
statements.evidence: Expression of cytotoxic GSDMB3/4 isoforms, but not GSDMB1/2 isoforms that are frequently up-regulated in tumors, was associated with better outcomes in bladder and cervical cancers
statements.note: The abstract reports cytotoxic GSDMB3/4 expression, unlike GSDMB1/2, was associated with better outcomes in bladder and cervical cancers.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: circPVT1 promotes tumorigenesis and endocrine therapy resistance in ERα-positive breast cancer.

statements.note: The abstract states circPVT1 is functionally important in promoting ERα-positive breast tumorigenesis and endocrine therapy resistance.
